correction_2026_11_07.what_was_wrong: The Checkpoint 1 audit recorded that Figure8NetComparison.mat holds coordinate matrices 'but the corresponding stimuli are not in that member, so they cannot be used for retrieval here'. That is FALSE.
correction_2026_11_07.what_is_actually_there: A `shapes` array of 1000 structs, each with `c` (384x2 float64 contour) and `lat` (25-D float32 GAN latent). SC is (1000,40) float64; matnet/kernet1/kernet2 are (1000,22) float32.
correction_2026_11_07.how_it_was_found: Direct scipy.io.loadmat inspection of the fetched member, after reading Figure8.m.
consequences: S0-MatNet and S0-KerNet1 move from 'unavailable' to 'outputs_only', matching S0-KerNet2.

The official Figure 8D correlations were recomputed from the raw arrays rather than quoted: pearson r = 0.9276 (MatNet), 0.9452 (KerNet1), 0.9100 (KerNet2) against pdist(SC) over all 40 columns, exactly as Figure8.m does. The paper quotes 0.93 / 0.94 / 0.91.

SC in this member is a 40-D MDS solution, NOT the 22-D ShapeComp space. Its first 22 columns retain 88.76% of its variance (the paper's animal space retains 95.05% in 22 dims), so they are not verified to be the canonical coordinates. Using only those 22 columns gives r = 0.9372 / 0.9527 / 0.9223 instead. The two bases must not be conflated.

The 1000 shapes are DISJOINT from the 500 human-rated H1 stimuli (0 exact contour matches; minimum SC-space nearest-neighbour distance 0.54). They carry no human ratings, so any use is model-vs-model, never human validation.
2 of the 1000 contours (indices 245, 711) are self-intersecting and are refused by standardize(), so a Figure 8 retrieval gallery would hold 998 shapes, not 1000.

The deposited `c` arrays are raw GAN contours, NOT the paper's min-max-normalised minimum-x-start network input. A retrieval comparison on this gallery would therefore confound descriptor differences with preprocessing differences.
correction_2026_11_07.not_done: No Figure 8 retrieval arm was run. It is recorded as a next-step option, not as a result.

translation_2026_11_08.what_was_translated: ONLY the preprocessing of getShapeComp22netkeras.m / getShapeComp22netimagekeras.m and the geom2d helpers (centroid, resamplePolygon, resamplePolyline, parametrize, adjustContourPos, clockwise, inpolygon->shapely.covers).
